correctness.rationale: The exact domain is the smooth locus of y^3=x^5+a x^3+b x+c in characteristic five, detected by Delta=a^5 c^2-3b^3(a^2+b)^2. Riemann-Hurwitz gives genus four; four explicit regular differentials yield a semilinear Cartier matrix via coefficients of F^3 at degrees 4,9,14. Its rank and stable rank prove the three stated pairs, with no unproved Newton-polygon implication. A quadratic-character count shows exactly q^2 singular triples and hence exact all-q marked frequencies. Standard-library finite-field code independently checked all F5/F25 discriminants and censuses and exact semilinear ranks for all F5 and 120 F25 samples. No experimental extrapolation is invoked.

evidence: Kudo constructs superspecial nonhyperelliptic genus-four curves in all primes congruent to 2 modulo 3; thus the superspecial existence part is explicitly treated as known.

originality.rationale: The novelty assessed is the specific complete (5-rank,a-number) coefficient stratification on the displayed odd-plus-constant quintic slice and its exact counts in every finite extension. Previously known superspecial genus-four examples, the existence and geometry of trielliptic p-rank strata, and the general cyclic trigonal equation are expressly prior work. Accessible full-text sources and indexed claim comparisons do not state or imply the complete marked classification. The inaccessible 2025 a-number article is a material residual priority risk and does not supply a justified claim of disjointness.
residual_risks: The full 2025 Sohn article is materially relevant and was not accessible. Its overlap with the a-number computation is unresolved; the accepted contribution is not a first a-number method claim.
Older or unindexed arithmetic tables could imply some finite-field counts or the specific rank-stratum conditions.
The counts distinguish coefficient-marked presentations only. Isomorphic presentations have not been classified, and no new abstract isomorphism classes are claimed.
p-rank zero is not asserted to mean supersingular Newton polygon for the non-superspecial stratum.

value.rationale: The six-branch-point genus-four trielliptic signature (3,1) is a natural moduli-theoretic object, and the displayed depressed odd-quintic slice deforms an automorphism-rich known model. The joint Cartier classification reveals two distinct rank-zero components (one known superspecial and one non-superspecial) with an exact smoothness boundary and complete arithmetic point counts in the coefficient parameter space. This resolves a concrete previously unextracted finite-field stratification that is neither a mere relabeling of a general existence theorem nor an arbitrary isolated invariant. Coefficient-marked counts are scientifically meaningful as parameter-space strata without a claim of isomorphism classification.
